name: wu-tang-generator-bootcamp
description: Feature A: Personality Based Name Generation: Uses answers from five survey questions to influence the randomly generated hip-hop alias, making each result feel more personalized and unique. Feature B: Server-Side Randomization: Sends the user’s choices to a Node.js server, where different word banks are combined to generate a new Wu-Tang-inspired name. Feature C: Interactive & Responsive Experience: Users can instantly generate another name while the interface remains simple, fast, and easy to use across screen sizes.
